When a later request resets the client window, MemoryStore.resetClient mutates that same Date, so an earlier request that finishes or disconnects after the reset can pass the stale-window guard and decrement the current window's count. CVE-2026-57142.description: PraisonAI is a multi-agent teams system. From version 4.5.87 to before version 4.6.61, PraisonAI recipe execution has a dangerous-tool policy that is supposed to block default-denied tools unless the caller explicitly passes allow_dangerous_tools=True. That policy only checks tools declared in TEMPLATE.yaml requires.tools. For steps-based recipes, the actual execution path loads workflow.yaml with YAMLWorkflowParser. CVE-2026-99467.title: media: marvell: mcam: stop DMA and cancel s_bh_work before freeing DMA buffers
CVE-2026-99467.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

media: marvell: mcam: stop DMA and cancel s_bh_work before freeing DMA buffers

In vmalloc mode the frame-completion IRQ queues mcam_frame_work() on
cam->s_bh_work, which memcpy()s from the dma_bufs[] that
mcam_free_dma_bufs() frees with dma_free_coherent(). mccic_shutdown()
frees those buffers without stopping the controller, so while streaming
a late frame IRQ can re-arm the work after the buffers are gone, causing a
use-after-free.

Stop the controller in mccic_shutdown() when streaming is still active
(gated on an open fd, which holds a runtime-PM reference, so the device
is powered), cancel s_bh_work in mcam_free_dma_bufs(), and move
INIT_WORK() into mccic_register() before the device can be published.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mptcp: pm: kernel: use RCU to free endpoint listeners

mptcp_pm_nl_create_listen_socket() starts the TCP listener directly
instead of going through mptcp_listen(). It consequently misses setting
SOCK_RCU_FREE on the parent MPTCP socket.

tcp_child_process() can invoke the listener's subflow_data_ready()
callback without holding the MPTCP parent lock or a reference to the
parent. An authenticated MP_JOIN racing with endpoint teardown can
therefore access the parent after its last reference has been dropped.
The ADD_ADDR error path can also close an already published listener.

Set SOCK_RCU_FREE before __inet_listen_sk() publishes the TCP listener,
matching mptcp_listen(). This protects the parent on every subsequent
close path, including a failed endpoint addition.
